slots.title: U.S. session recap — Oct. 27, 2026
slots.body:
The S&P 500 rose 0.6% to 7,722.65 (+45.88 pts).
The Nasdaq Composite gained 1.2% to 26,477.81 (+308.43).
The Russell 2000 added 1.2% to 2,818.87 (+32.45).
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was essentially flat, up less than 0.1% to 52,377.57 (+15.99).

$BBA was the standout megacap decliner, down 10.7% to 168.18 after EPS of -0.34 vs about -0.25 expected; revenue was about $24.19B vs about $23.95B expected.
The day low 167.43 sat almost on the 52-week low of 167.41.

Semiconductor and large-cap tech names helped carry the Nasdaq.:
- $AMD +5.5% to 560.26
- $TSM +2.9% to 436.87
- $ORCL +3.5% to 130.53
- $NVDA +0.9% to 217.94

$TSLA rose 4.0% to 407.46.
$MSFT slipped 0.2% to 531.33.
$AMZN gained 1.6% to 253.10.

Earnings drove several large moves beyond Boeing.:
- $UPS +5.8% to 106.14
- $RCL +5.5% to 295.92
- $CRM -2.7% to 240.89
- $V -0.6% to 401.86
- $KO -1.6% to 91.18

after EPS 0.91 vs 0.88 est and revenue above estimate.

Sector averages on Nasdaq showed Healthcare up about 1.3%, Consumer Cyclical about 1.2%, Real Estate about 1.2%, Technology about 0.9%, and Consumer Defensive down about 0.8%.
Financial Services averaged about -0.6%.

Energy-linked megacaps weakened: $XOM -2.5% to 179.88 and $CVX -1.6% to 228.23.
The USO ETF proxy closed down 1.4% at 163.88.
Brent crude futures rose 1.3% to 115.40.

Data released during the session included September durable goods orders up 1.8% month over month (estimate 1.5%), ex-transportation up 0.5%, and ex-defense up 2.2%.
September new home sales were 0.676M with month-over-month change -0.6% (estimate -3.5%).
October Conference Board consumer confidence printed 91.7 vs 81.0 expected (prior 84.2).
Atlanta Fed GDPNow for Q3 was 3.4% vs 3.5% prior.

The CBOE VIX fell 4.7% to 17.52.
Gold futures (GC) were down 0.4% at 4,058.80.
The UUP dollar fund proxy rose 0.4% to 29.12.
Bitcoin traded about 0.2% higher around 80,990.56.

Overseas references in the bundle included Nikkei 225 +1.5%, Hang Seng +0.4%, FTSE 100 -0.8%, and the Germany ETF proxy EWG +0.7%.
Latest Treasury snapshot in the feed (dated 2026-10-23) showed the 10-year at 5.0% and the 2s10s spread at 0.31.

Core PCE price index (Sep, year-over-year): estimate 3.1%, prior 3.0%.

- Initial jobless claims (Oct/24): estimate 199K, prior 194K  
- Personal income (Sep, month-over-month): estimate 0.3%, prior 0.2%

ET.
